summary: Every new statement in the current diff matches the mathematics: hand checks of sqrt_neg, etaMultiplier_neg, the c = 0 and inverse branch-cut cases, the odd c < 0 Kronecker formula at (-1 0; -1 -1), the coprime-to-6 simplification, and the χ₄ quarter-period lemma all agree. The PR description still claims declarations, a file, and a Rademacher-based proof of ε²⁴ = 1 that do not exist, so the record of what was proven is false.
